text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Zimbabwe's Grain Marketing Board has abolished the stop order system for making payments to producers which it had been operating for decades, in a move designed to regain lost market share.

- Management at state-owned Air Zimbabwe has set up a four-man team and invited a similar composition of people representing striking pilots and flight engineers in an attempt to break the current impasse between the two parties. The pilots and engineers on Friday went on strike demanding higher salaries.
